My lorde of Caunterberries
Brothe for a Consumptione
Take, like as before sauinge putt thereto a handfull of violett leaues
langdebeefe leaues Borrage leaues and Strawberrie leaues, knitt
togeather of euerie one alike quantitie.
For the pyles
Take one handsfull of mullen leaues, and wrappe them in a Colewort
leafe, and rake them in the Embers vntill they bee well rosted
then take them, and putt awaye the Coleworte leafe, and grande
them in a morter, and putt to yt oyle of roses, and drinke them togeather
then take itt and laye itt to the pyles withe a trusser, and vse this
mornenge and euenynge.
For the fflixe
Take horssedunge new made and frie itt withe sweete butter
and putt itt in a Clothe and laye itt to the fundament as hott
as you maye suffer ytt, and sitte vppon vntill yow haue ease.
For Deffnes
Take blacke woole, wheche growes vppon the flanke
of a sheepe and Tarre and mingell them togeather
and putt them into the eare.

Broathe for a Consumption
Take like as before sauinge putt thereto a hansfull of violet leaues
and a hansfull of betteony leaues Brouage leaues and strawberrie leaues, with
the gather of euerie one alike quantitie.

For the pyles
Take one handfull of mallow leaues, and wrappe them in a Coleworte
leafe, and rake them in the imbers vntill they bee well rosted
